prompt.en: Which part of Canada is often called the Land of the Midnight Sun?
prompt.fr: Quelle partie du Canada appelle-t-on souvent le pays du soleil de minuit?

explanation.en: The North carries that name because at the height of summer the daylight there can last almost the whole day and night.
explanation.fr: Le Nord porte ce nom parce qu'au cœur de l'été, la clarté peut y durer presque tout le jour et toute la nuit.

source.quote: The North is often referred to as the “Land of the Midnight Sun” because at the height of summer, daylight can last up to 24 hours.
